question: In which of the following states is the Goncha Festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The tribes of the Bastar region celebrate the Goncha festival.
 
• It is celebrated during the time of Rathyatra.
 
• It is also called the Chariot or Gundicha festival.
 
• In this festival, just like Jagganathpuri, 22 idols from Jagganath Temple (Jagdalpur) are taken in&nb
